events.title: Jacques Cartier plants a cross at Gaspé and claims it for France
events.description: Jacques Cartier raised a nine-metre wooden cross at Gaspé Bay bearing the arms of the King of France. The gesture began French claims to the St Lawrence region that became New France.
events.html: Jacques Cartier raised a nine-metre wooden cross at Gaspé Bay bearing the arms of the King of France. The gesture began French claims to the St Lawrence region that became New France.

events.title: Mary, Queen of Scots is forced to abdicate
events.description: Imprisoned at Lochleven, Mary was compelled to abdicate in favour of her one-year-old son, crowned James VI five days later. She fled to England in 1568 and was executed in 1587.
events.html: Imprisoned at Lochleven, Mary was compelled to abdicate in favour of her one-year-old son, crowned James VI five days later. She fled to England in 1568 and was executed in 1587.

events.title: Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac founds Detroit
events.description: French officer Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac established Fort Pontchartrain du Détroit on the strait between Lakes Erie and Huron. The trading post grew into Detroit, later the heart of the US car industry.
events.html: French officer Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac established Fort Pontchartrain du Détroit on the strait between Lakes Erie and Huron. The trading post grew into Detroit, later the heart of the US car industry.

events.title: Brigham Young's Mormon pioneers enter the Salt Lake Valley
events.description: After a long trek from Illinois, Brigham Young's vanguard company entered the Great Salt Lake Valley; he reportedly declared 'This is the right place'. Salt Lake City became the centre of the Latter-day Saints.
events.html: After a long trek from Illinois, Brigham Young's vanguard company entered the Great Salt Lake Valley; he reportedly declared 'This is the right place'. Salt Lake City became the centre of the Latter-day Saints.

events.title: Hiram Bingham reaches the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu
events.description: Guided by local farmer Melchor Arteaga, Yale lecturer Hiram Bingham climbed to Machu Picchu, already known to local families. His photographs made the Inca site world-famous.
events.html: Guided by local farmer Melchor Arteaga, Yale lecturer Hiram Bingham climbed to Machu Picchu, already known to local families. His photographs made the Inca site world-famous.

events.title: Supreme Court orders Nixon to hand over the Watergate tapes
events.description: In United States v. Nixon the Supreme Court ruled 8-0 that the president must surrender the tapes. Their contents destroyed his remaining support, and he resigned 16 days later.
